title: Lay the windows out as rows
hints: Run it and compare the rows. Which variable does the inner function never use?
Row `i` is the window that starts at `x.(i)`. Its element `j` sits `j` steps after that.

answer.explain: Window `i` starts at `x.(i)`, so its element `j` is `x.(i + j)`. There are `Array.length x - k + 1` windows. Neighboring rows share `k - 1` numbers, which is the copying that implicit GEMM avoids.
